'''Haddius Korden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]], Korden reformed [[House Korden|his family's]] business into [[Korden Outfitting and Surveying]], a firm that supplied equipment to colonists.
